images.title: Eight thirds of a banana
images.purpose: Show that eight pieces of 1/3 banana make two whole bananas and two pieces more, written as the mixed number 2 2/3.
images.composition: Two whole bananas and one part banana in a row with wide gaps, and the mixed number shown large below with how it is read.
images.exact_structure: Three identical simple flat bananas drawn as straight rounded bars, side by side with wide gaps. Each is split by thin grey #6B7280 lines into exactly 3 equal pieces. First two bananas: all 3 pieces filled teal #0072B2. Third banana: 2 pieces filled amber #E69F00, the last piece a dashed grey outline only. Below, centred: the equation, then the mixed number 2 2/3 large, its 2 teal and its 2/3 amber, then the reading. Exactly 8 filled pieces.

images.takeaway: Eight thirds is two and two thirds, written 2 2/3.
images.description: Two whole teal bananas of 3 thirds each and a third banana with 2 amber thirds; below, 8/3 = 2 + 2/3, the mixed number 2 2/3, and the reading two and two thirds.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the teal 2 and the amber 2/3 and read the mixed number aloud.

image_decisions.why: Wholes and leftover pieces map straight onto the two parts of a mixed number in one picture.
